name: mouse_control
description:
Low-level mouse input for canvas/drawing. AVOID for buttons/controls - use ui_automation(click) instead. BEFORE USING: Get coordinates from ui_automation(find) bounding rects OR screenshot_control(annotate=true). Never guess positions. USE FOR: drag operations, canvas drawing, custom controls without UIA. DRAG: Use x,y for START and endX,endY for END position (NOT startX/startY). Actions: move, click, double_click, right_click, middle_click, drag, scroll, get_position.
MONITOR TARGETING:'primary_screen': Target the main display (with taskbar). Most common choice.'secondary_screen': Target the other monitor. Only works with exactly 2 monitors.monitorIndex: For 3+ monitors, use screenshot_control action='list_monitors' first to find the index.COORDINATES: All x/y coordinates are relative to the specified monitor.MONITOR CONTEXT: Successful operations with explicit coordinates return monitor_index, monitor_width, and monitor_height in the response.QUERY POSITION: Use action='get_position' to query current cursor position with monitor context.
Returns: The result includes success status, cursor position, monitor context, and 'target_window' for click actions.

action.description: The mouse action to perform: move, click, double_click, right_click, middle_click, drag, scroll, or get_position.

target.description: Monitor target: 'primary_screen' (main display with taskbar), 'secondary_screen' (other monitor in 2-monitor setups). For 3+ monitors, use monitorIndex instead.

x.description: X-coordinate relative to the monitor's left edge (required for move, optional for clicks).

y.description: Y-coordinate relative to the monitor's top edge (required for move, optional for clicks).

endX.description: End x-coordinate relative to the monitor (required for drag action).

endY.description: End y-coordinate relative to the monitor (required for drag action).

direction.description: Scroll direction: up, down, left, or right (required for scroll action).

modifiers.description: Modifier keys to hold during action: ctrl, shift, alt (comma-separated).

button.description: Mouse button for drag: left, right, or middle (default: left).

monitorIndex.description: Monitor index (0-based). Alternative to target for 3+ monitor setups. Use screenshot_control action='list_monitors' to find indices.

expectedWindowTitle.description: Expected window title (partial match). If specified, operation fails if foreground window title doesn't match.

expectedProcessName.description: Expected process name. If specified, operation fails if foreground window's process doesn't match.

windowHandle.description: Window handle for window-relative coordinates. When provided, x/y are relative to the window's top-left corner.
